failure_summary.description: Selected broad or category-only news endpoints where the request called for a specific source or for news matching both region and category.
Omitted requested outputs or substituted unrelated calls in compound requests.
Produced malformed JSON or call objects that did not match the required parameter structure.
Used a noncanonical value or failed to carry a requested qualifier into the endpoint parameters.
Shortened tool names instead of using their complete listed names.

patch.reasoning: The clearest actionable gap is choosing between source-specific and general feeds: the existing endpoint-selection guidance does not make that tie-break explicit. The skill already covers compound-request audits, exact tool names, schema checks, and serialization, so those failures do not warrant duplicating existing guidance.

edits.content: - When a request names a specific publisher, source, or feed, use its source-specific endpoint when available; a general aggregator filtered by language or region is not equivalent. For broad or global latest-news requests, use a broad-feed endpoint rather than inventing a keyword search or adding overlapping feeds. Choose an endpoint that can satisfy the full set of qualifiers for that output.
